prompt:
A sprite sheet of 4 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 2 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) a way-lamp of the snow country: a carved block of clear blue-white ICE hollowed into a lantern, standing on a short pillar of stacked grey fieldstones capped with snow, a thick candle inside, UNLIT (the ice is cool blue, the candle dark); 2) the SAME ice way-lamp LIT: the candle burning, the ice glowing warm golden from inside; 3) a small conical HIDE TENT of the northern hunters: long wooden poles crossing at the top, brown and grey fur and hide coverings sewn together, snow on its shoulders, the door flap tied open showing a dark inside; 4) a small ground lantern made of a hollowed ICE block on the snow with a candle stub inside (unlit).
Scale: the way-lamp is about 50 art pixels tall, the tent about 32 art pixels tall, the ground lantern about 12 art pixels tall; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels. Items 1 and 2 must be identical in size, shape and colours except that 2 is lit.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Exception: in the lit variant the ice may glow, but no light spills onto anything around it.
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Generate a clean transparent-background sprite sheet of four separate top-down 3/4-view JRPG pixel-art props, arranged as a spacious 2-by-2 grid in reading order, with ample transparent gaps and safe margins. Each upright prop shows its top and front, base toward bottom. Top-left: a roughly 50-art-pixel-tall snow-country way-lamp: a carved clear icy blue-white rectangular hollow ice lantern around a thick DARK UNLIT candle, atop a short pillar of stacked gray fieldstones with snowy cap. Top-right: precisely the SAME way-lamp, same silhouette, dimensions, stone pillar, snow and details, but candle is burning and the ice is illuminated from within in warm amber/golden colors; absolutely no light spill outside lamp. Bottom-left: approximately 32-art-pixel-tall small conical northern hunter hide tent with long wooden poles crossing above apex, patched stitched brown and gray fur/hide covering, snow on shoulders, tied-open door flap exposing dark interior. Bottom-right: approximately 12-art-pixel-tall small ground lantern: hollowed clear blue-white ice block with an unlit dark candle stub inside, small snow edging immediately on the lantern itself; no ground beneath. Relative sizes must be clear (way-lamps tallest, tent intermediate, ground lantern tiny). Premium hand-placed modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, strictly uniform large square pixels throughout, hard pixel-perfect edges, clustered color shapes, no antialiasing, no blur, no noise, no photographic textures, no dithering. Rich earthy palette with 4–6 shades per material; saturated purple-red-leaning shadows and warm-yellow-leaning highlights. Even neutral overcast upper-left ambient illumination, no cast shadows or pools of light. Background completely transparent, no scenery, ground, drop shadow, labels, letters, numbers, borders, or frames. Every prop entirely separated and fully within canvas.
